sources.title_en: Introducing harness adapters: adapt your favorite model to your harness to improve performance and cost
sources.title_original: Introducing harness adapters: adapt your favorite model to your harness to improve performance and cost
sources.summary:
We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
Combining RL on a custom task distribution with your favorite agent harness yields more accurate and efficient models for that target harness and task distribution.
Models are not fully optimized for all harnesses and the tasks you’re doing. Instead, they target general performance.
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章介绍 harness adapters：以 Qwen3.8-27B 为例，在 pi harness 的 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上从 39% 提升到 55% pass@1，平均 token 从 2.9K 降至 1.5K，并给出在 Pi、OpenCode、Hermes Agent 上复用的 RL 训练配方。

en.reason: Harness adapters, illustrated with Qwen3.8-27B on pi harness’s Terminal-Bench 2.1, lift pass@1 from 39% to 55% while cutting average tokens from 2.9K to 1.5K, with RL training recipes reusable across Pi, OpenCode and Hermes Agent.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 在 Google 新一期《Dialogues on Technology and Society》中，Kent Walker 与 Walter Isaacson 借 Leonardo da Vinci、Benjamin Franklin、Ada Lovelace 的经历，讨论历史突破为何常是团队合作，以及信息唾手可得时 AI 时代的好奇心与人类判断力为何更关键。

en.reason: Walter Isaacson tells Google’s Kent Walker in Dialogues on Technology and Society that Leonardo da Vinci, Benjamin Franklin and Ada Lovelace show breakthroughs are often team efforts and curiosity plus human judgment matter more as AI makes information abundant.
